name: @tabhandoff/desktop
description: TabHandoff desktop — local AI activity and evidence library

scripts.build: tsup src/main.ts src/preload.ts --format esm --outDir dist --clean --external electron && node ./scripts/copy-renderer.mjs
scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
